symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of prime cyclic axes, with no coefficient axis counted.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes (unlike on the [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md) page, no coefficient axis is counted), let $i$ index them, let $s_i$ be the length of axis $i$, the lengths being pairwise coprime, and let $S=s_1\cdots s_d$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes (unlike on the [Cyclic convolution](convolution.md) page, no coefficient axis is counted), let $i$ index them, let $s_i$ be the length of axis $i$, the lengths being pairwise coprime, and let $S=s_1\cdots s_d$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of source axis i, pairwise coprime with the other axis lengths.

symbols.name: prefix product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths of the axes before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: exponent
symbols.meaning: The inverse of P_i modulo s_i, the exponent of x_i in the image of x.
symbols.quote: Let $P_i=\prod_{j<i}s_j$ be the product of the lengths of the axes before axis $i$, and $\mu_i=P_i^{-1}\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: address map
symbols.meaning: The algebra isomorphism from the cyclic ring of length S to the product of cyclic rings on the axes, sending x to the product of x_i^{mu_i}.
symbols.quote: Define $\Phi:\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)\to\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$ by $x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The polynomial variable of axis i.
symbols.quote: Define $\Phi:\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)\to\mathbb C[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(x_i^{s_i}-1)$ by $x\mapsto\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, with one variable $x_i$ per axis.

symbols.name: mixed-radix digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of the coefficient index k in position j, with 0 <= a_j < s_j.
symbols.quote: Write $k=\sum_ja_jP_j$ in mixed radix, with digits $0\le a_j<s_j$.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate along axis i of the image of x^k.
symbols.quote: The axis-$i$ coordinate $b_i$ of $\Phi(x^k)$ is $\mu_ik\bmod s_i$.

symbols.name: address bits
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits of an axis of length r.
symbols.quote: Pad axis $i$ with zero records to a length $t_i$, a power of two with $r/2\le t_i\le r$, where $r=2^\ell$ and $\ell$ is the number of address bits of an axis of length $r$.

symbols.name: padded record count
symbols.meaning: The number of padded records, the product of the padded axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $T=\prod_it_i$ be the number of padded records, each of $O(p)$ bits.

symbols.name: interchange exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 in the cost of the chunk interchange.

symbols.name: address width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits of each of two equal-width axes being interchanged.
symbols.quote: A [chunk interchange](address-interchange.md) exchanges two axes of equal address width $L$ in $O(VL^\tau)$ time
